title: Surface Rust and Python Tests in VSCode Test Editor

Fix .vscode/settings.json and any configuration so rust-analyzer Test Explorer surfaces the Rust tests and the Python extension discovers the pytest tests.
summary: Accidentally reopened by automated tool, closing immediately. No changes made.
